answer: Make every agent's reputation grow like a vine: each completed service earns a signed receipt from a real counterparty, and receipts chain together into one verifiable voyage of work. A newcomer starts at the bottom and climbs toward the zenith only by accumulating genuine receipts over time, with no shortcut and no bulk purchase. A farm of a thousand clones would need a thousand separate histories of real paid work, each checked against independent counterparties, so the cost of faking scales linearly while an honest agent climbs once and keeps its standing.
